purpose: Admit the B-5 bidirectional indexes as the only production ownership inputs for Hero Stage 5-2 exclusive-equipment display and Equipment-page owner-Hero display without duplicating or re-deriving ownership.

publicationGate.relationBlobRule: Both indexes must reference the same exact relation blob SHA pinned by B-5/B-4.
publicationGate.scopeRule: Only the frozen 167 exclusive-equipment relations are admitted. General Equipment remains outside Stage B.

heroConsumer.metadataJoin: Join returned equipmentId to data/generated/equipment_stage3_5_exclusive_consumer.json by equipmentId for display/detail fields.
heroConsumer.absenceSemantics: A canonical Hero ID missing from byHeroId has no current released exclusive-equipment ownership edge in this snapshot; do not synthesize an owner relation.
forbiddenOwnershipInputs: ConfigDataEquipmentInfo.SkillHero direct reads in page-consumer code
legacy Hero Stage 5-2 ownerHeroId/ownerResolver fields as production authority
icons, ordering, release chronology or numeric patterns

equipmentConsumer.consumer: Exclusive Equipment detail/list owner-Hero display and navigation
equipmentConsumer.heroMetadataJoin: Join returned heroId to data/hero-name-master.v1.json by exact heroId.
equipmentConsumer.equipmentMetadataSource: data/generated/equipment_stage3_5_exclusive_consumer.json remains the 167-record display/detail payload and does not derive ownership.
forbiddenOwnershipInputs: direct ConfigData ownership re-derivation in page-consumer code

legacyTransition.policy: The snapshot remains valid historical evidence that the old direct SkillHero implementation produced the same 167 ownership pairs and 100 NOT_RELEASED Hero states. After B-6 it is not an ownership semantic source for future page composition.
legacyTransition.centralDisciplineBoundary: B-6 changes only exclusive-equipment ownership authority. Hero Stage 5-2 central-discipline data remains governed by its existing source and is not migrated into Stage B.

nonDuplication.reason: B-5 indexes already provide the minimal consumer projections. B-6 records admission and parity only; it does not create a third copy of the 167 relation pairs.

validationRequirements: B-5 is PASS / COMPLETE and both indexes pin the same validated relation blob SHA.
byHero contains exactly 167 ownership relations and leaves exactly 100 canonical Heroes without an ownership key.
byEquipment contains exactly the same 167 equipment IDs as Equipment Stage 3-5 exclusive consumer listRecords.
Every byEquipment owner Hero exists in the canonical 267 Hero master.
The legacy Hero Stage 5-2 released ownership pair set exactly equals the byHero pair set; its 100 NOT_RELEASED Heroes exactly equal canonical Heroes missing from byHero.
Hero 6 resolves to Equipment 416 through byHero and Equipment 416 resolves to Hero 6 through byEquipment.
General Equipment admission count is zero and no page consumer needs ArmyIds/JobIds to resolve ownership.
No new ownership pair is generated in B-6.
downstreamRule: Future Hero and Equipment page composition must consume the B-5 indexes for ownership and may join display metadata afterward. If ownership changes, regenerate/revalidate Stage B instead of patching page outputs.
completion: B-6 is complete when both page directions are formally admitted to the B-5 indexes, legacy direct SkillHero ownership is demoted to parity-only evidence, 167/167 consumer coverage and 100-Hero absence parity pass, and no general-equipment or heuristic ownership path is admitted.
